open_set.novelty_threshold: 5th percentile of validation maximum cosine similarity to same-design training class prototypes

cross_node.target: all iccad1 official-test center clips in components that contain no official-training image; manifest.cross_target

uncertainty.method: component bootstrap on seed-and-support-draw averaged sample predictions

selection_policy: Fixed training length and method set; no selection by test scores.
limitation: The dataset was explored in v1. A revised locked protocol does not undo historical exposure. Duplicate control does not prove absence of arbitrary spatial overlap.

split.support_tune_test: test-only components approximately 20/20/60, rare-class support/tune minimum 5 rows when feasible
split.exclusion: official-test images in any connected component containing an official-training image
split.fewshot_sampling: distinct dup_key per design and class; cap at available unique keys and report actual count
